baseline.model_method: BatchedMatmul source roofline, no launch overhead, no optimized Hydragen fusion

cim.macro_source: Sinangil JSSC 2021 reported fabricated 7nm unsigned I4W4O4 macro
cim.qk_precision: signed Q4K4 with O4 ADC response

interpretation: For the fixed operator decomposition and specified conditional 7nm CIM serial rates, the source-native FP16 A100 roofline model estimates too little QK work saved to amortize Q4K4 CIM programming, execution, reduction and score transport. This is a modeled negative result, not a universal exclusion against an optimized measured GPU.
scope: Comparing FP16 source GPU operator model with lower-precision Q4K4O4 CIM source model; numerical quality differs.
GPU full attention post-QK softmax/PV and other decoder stages canceled by assumption; score recombination is set to zero (favors CIM).
Source model roofline difference is neither measured A100 runtime nor a mathematical upper bound on GPU QK savings.
CIM periphery area, ports and interface rates are explicit conditional sensitivities; no fabricated integrated 7nm accelerator.
No full decoder TPOT or speedup asserted.
